Container.Name: Digarr
Container.Overview:
AI-powered music discovery engine for self-hosted music stacks. Connects to Lidarr, Last.fm, ListenBrainz, Spotify, and more to find new artists you will actually like. Supports auto-playlists, subscription feeds, mood-based discovery, and genre browsing.
Ships with a built-in embedded database -- no separate PostgreSQL container needed. Data is stored in the mapped data folder (/mnt/user/appdata/digarr/data), which must be writable by the container user (uid 1000). To use an external PostgreSQL instead, set the (advanced) Database URL variable.
Container.Requires: No separate database required -- uses a built-in embedded database by default. The data folder (/mnt/user/appdata/digarr/data) must be writable by the container user (uid 1000). Optionally point Database URL at an external PostgreSQL instance.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the built-in embedded database. Must be writable by the container user (uid 1000).

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Container path for the built-in embedded database (matches the Data folder mapping)

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Leave empty to use the built-in database. Set only to use an external PostgreSQL, e.g. postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/digarr

Config.Name: Initial Username
Config.Description: Auto-create this admin user on first boot

Config.Name: Initial Password
Config.Description: Password for the initial admin user (min 8 chars)

Config.Name: AI Provider
Config.Description: AI provider: anthropic, openai, gemini, ollama, openai-compatible (or configure in UI)

Config.Name: AI Model
Config.Description: Model name, e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-4-5-20250514

Config.Name: AI API Key
Config.Description: API key for the AI provider

Config.Name: AI Base URL
Config.Description: Base URL for openai-compatible or ollama (e.g. http://ollama:11434)

Config.Name: Lidarr URL
Config.Description: Lidarr instance URL, e.g. http://lidarr:8686 (optional -- discovery works without Lidarr)

Config.Name: Lidarr API Key
Config.Description: Lidarr API key (Settings > General in Lidarr)

Config.Name: ListenBrainz Username
Config.Description: ListenBrainz username for taste analysis

Config.Name: ListenBrainz Token
Config.Description: ListenBrainz user token

Config.Name: Last.fm Username
Config.Description: Last.fm username for taste analysis

Config.Name: Last.fm API Key
Config.Description: Last.fm API key

Config.Name: Allowed Origin
Config.Description: CORS allowed origin, e.g. https://digarr.example.com (required for reverse proxy)

Config.Name: Allow Insecure Cookies
Config.Description: Cookies default to Secure in production, even behind a TLS-terminating proxy. Set true ONLY for an intentional direct-HTTP deployment (pair with an http:// Allowed Origin); direct HTTP exposes the session cookie to interception.

Config.Name: Encryption Key
Config.Description: 32+ char key for encrypting API keys, tokens, and connection passwords (blank stores those fields unencrypted)

Config.Name: Disable Registration
Config.Description: Set to false to allow new user registration

Config.Name: Skip TLS Verify
Config.Description: Skip TLS certificate verification for Lidarr/Jellyfin connections

Config.Name: Webhook URL
Config.Description: Discord HTTPS webhook or public HTTPS endpoint that accepts Digarr JSON
